verified_against: GravityGunRevival-1.20.1-1.1.0.jar (CurseForge project 1452616, 'iChun Gravity Gun Mod Revival' by DalterDile81; file 8602200, stable - the mod left beta with 1.0.0)
note: A faithful 1.20.1 Forge port of iChun's 1.12.2 Gravity Gun. Namespace is gravitygun, same as the original. The alternative on CurseForge is Cloro's Gravity Gun (project 895998, namespace physics_gun_mod, Garry's-Mod-flavoured: physics gun, tool gun, portal thrower); it is a different mod, record it separately if ever wanted. The colored gun recipes in this jar consume paintball:*_paintbrush items from the same author's Paintball Mod Revival - without that mod installed the colored variants are unobtainable, so only the three ids in the chain below are safe quest targets on their own.

chain.title: Zero-Point Energy
chain.desc: Shaped recipe from a diamond, four ender pearls, two iron ingots, glowstone and obsidian. Left click punts whatever you are looking at; right click picks up a block or a mob and carries it in front of you until you drop or launch it.

chain.title: Read the Manual
chain.desc: The mod's in-game guidebook. Its recipe is a custom code-defined type (gravitygun:gravity_book), so the ingredients are not readable from the data json - verify in-game or with JEI before questing a craft task on it; a plain 'have the item' task is safe.

chain.title: Supercharged
chain.desc: Shapeless: the Gravity Gun plus a Nether Star, so the upgrade is gated behind a Wither kill. The blue supercharged gun grabs and launches far heavier targets, mirroring the Citadel sequence of Half-Life 2.

collections.name: painted guns (require the Paintball Mod Revival's paintbrushes)
